This is not an evaluation of proposals but an assessment of vendors� capabilities. Therefore, a high-level assessment of the capability statements will be performed. Generic brochures are not being requested. Vendors should provide information to stress their competencies, differentiators, and past performance showing or demonstrating their ability to fulfill PWS requirements. This requirement is set-aside for the General Services Administration (GSA) Aliant 3 Government-wide Acquisition Contract (GWAC) holders. Each capability response must address the questions below. Responses that do not address the questions may not be evaluated or considered in the Government�s market research. Generic corporate brochures, marketing materials, or general descriptions of services that do not directly address the questions are insufficient. 1. Does your organization have experience working with government agencies such as Ginnie Mae, the Federal Housing Administration (FHA), Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or the Office of Public and Indian Housing (PIH) providing services similar in scope, size and complexity as the Performance Work Statement (PWS) requirements? 2. Does your organization possess the following special qualifications: an active Software Engineering Institute (SEI) CMMI Level III Certificate for Development, an active corporate ISO/IEC 20000 certification, an active corporate ISO 9001 (Quality Management) certification. 3. Describe your experience and current capability to support the MBSOA PWS services: 1) MBS Data Collection & Reporting services, 2) Information Technology services and Operations & Maintenance (O&M) services including Security and Enhancement activities, and 3) specialized MBS Risk and Information Analytic services. Include any related Ginnie Mae experience. Please indicate if your firm served as the prime contractor or subcontractor. 4. Provide examples of your company's experience supporting, managing, and modernizing a multi-platform, multi-provider environment that includes integrated legacy applications hosted in the cloud, while ensuring compliance with applicable requirements. 5. Provide an example where your firm improved operational efficiency, risk management, and information analytics capabilities, as well as investor reporting capabilities and accuracy for a client with similar requirements as this PWS within the secondary mortgage market or government-backed residential lending market. Include quantifiable results. 6. What are the three to five greatest risks associated with separating IT O&M from MBS business operations during contract period of performance, and what contractual, governance, technical, or operation controls would your company recommend to mitigate those risks? 7. Describe your company�s approach and protocol for maintaining 24/7/365 application and system availability, particularly during high-traffic events. Detail how your team identifies and mitigates technical challenges. 8. Based on your review of the PWS, are there any recommended changes, additions, or clarifications? Please identify the page number and paragraph. 9. Is your company able and willing to commit to providing services for a 10-year contract term? If not, please explain any limitations or concerns. If your organization has the potential capacity to perform these contract services, please provide the following information: 1) organization name, address, email address, website address, telephone number, and size and type of ownership for the organization; and 2) tailored capability statements addressing the questions and/or requested information listed above, with appropriate documentation supporting claims of organizational and staff capability. If significant subcontracting or teaming is anticipated in order to deliver technical capability, organizations should address the administrative and management structure of such arrangements. The government will evaluate market information to ascertain potential market capacity to 1) provide services consistent in scope and scale with those described in this notice and otherwise anticipated; 2) secure and apply the full range of corporate financial, human capital, and technical resources required to successfully perform similar requirements; 3) implement a successful project management plan that includes: compliance with program schedules; cost containment; meeting and tracking performance; hiring and retention of personnel and risk mitigation; and 4) provide services under a performance based service acquisition contract. Based on the responses to this Sources Sought Notice/Market Research, this requirement may be further set aside for any of the socio-economic programs, set-aside for small business competition, procured through full and open competition, procured through GSA, etc. Interested potential offerors must clearly specify the following: their Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), business size applicable to NAICS, socioeconomic business categories, GSA GWAC contract number, and any other applicable GWAC numbers. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding their submissions. Submission Instructions: Interested parties who consider themselves qualified to perform the above-listed services are invited to submit a response to this Sources Sought Notice by November 6, 2026, on or before 2:00 PM EST. All responses under this Sources Sought Notice must be emailed to Kimberly Campbell at Kimberly.M.Campbell@hud.gov and Jennifer Perez at Jennifer.M.Perez@hud.gov. Additional information on the required services is listed below. If you have any questions concerning this opportunity, please contact the Contracting Officer, Kimberly Campbell at Kimberly.M.Campbell@hud.gov and the Contract Specialist, Jennifer Perez, at Jennifer.M.Perez@hud.gov. Background: See Attachment A- Draft MBSOA PWS, Section 1.2. The Contractor shall support Ginnie Mae's core business functions: 1) Data Collection and Reporting, 2) System Support Services, as well as 3) Analysis and Risk Services. The Contractor is responsible for maintaining existing business applications and operations and for performing comprehensive risk management and data analysis activities necessary for Ginnie Mae to manage its financial risk as well as the financial risk of its program participants. title: FEMA Request for Information - Direct Housing Modernization Capabilities
description: This Request for Information (RFI) is issued in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulations Overhaul (RFO) 15.101(c). This RFI does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Invitation for Bid (IFB), or Request for Quotation (RFQ), and it is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government to enter into a contract, nor will the Government pay for the information submitted in response to this request. All information contained in this RFI is preliminary and is subject to change if, and when, a solicitation is issued. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the U.S. Government to form a binding contract. If a competitive solicitation is released, it will be synopsized on the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) website. It is the responsibility of the interested parties to monitor this site for additional information pertaining to this RFI, or future solicitations. The Department of Homeland Security, Federal Emergency Management Agency, Office of Direct Housing Operations, is conducting market research to identify and seek capabilities from industry in five primary functional areas: Automated Real Estate Aggregation and Vacancy Sourcing - Automated discovery and ingestion of residential rental property listings via Multiple Listing Services (MLS), property management software APIs, commercial rental boards, and direct landlord entry portals. - Real-time vacancy validation to prevent matching against obsolete or unavailable listings. - Rapid geo-fencing within disaster-declared zones and surrounding reasonable-commute perimeters. Artificial Intelligence and Algorithmic Matching - Multi-constraint matching algorithms that pair applicant household profiles with available properties in seconds. - Multi-point geospatial proximity optimization factoring in school district retention, work commutes, medical/provider travel distance, and essential services. - Household composition sizing aligned with HUD Housing Quality Standards (HQS) and FEMA occupancy guidelines. Automated Physical Accessibility Verification - Algorithmic filtering and computer vision inspection tools capable of evaluating floor plans, entry photos, and property specifications against UFAS and ADA physical accessibility standards. - Rapid identification of barrier-free environments, ramps, ground-floor units, grab bars, and wheelchair-accessible kitchens and bathrooms. Landlord Engagement and Leasing Workflow Automation - Automated outreach tools and self-service portals for landlords to submit properties, accept lease terms, and coordinate inspections. - Integration with standard government lease templates and automated electronic signature workflows. Secure Federal Architecture - Enterprise data security architecture compliant with the Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) at the Moderate impact baseline. - FedRAMP-authorized cloud hosting (or capability to achieve FedRAMP Moderate/High authorization). - Strict data protection for Sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) belonging to disaster survivors. NAICS CODE: 541512 (Computer Systems Design Services) / 531210 (Offices of Real Estate Agents and Brokers) PRODUCT SERVICE CODE (PSC): X1FA, Lease/Rental of Family Housing Facilities ANTICIPATED PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE START DATE: TBD RFI RESPONSE SUBMITTAL INSTRUCTIONS: Interested contractors shall submit Questions and RFI responses electronically to the Contracting Officer, at Rachel.Woods@fema.dhs.gov no later than 12:00PM Eastern Time (ET), December 18, 2026. Phone calls will not be accepted. Please see the attachment for further instructions and information.

title: Utilities Privatization of the Water System at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii (USAG-HI), Island of Oahu
description: DLA Energy, in conjunction with the United States Army, plans to offer the privatization of the Water distribution (NAICS 221310) utility system at U.S. Army Garrison-Hawaii, Island of Oahu. Utilities Privatization (UP) is defined as the transfer of ownership and responsibility to a municipal, private, regional, district, or cooperative utility company or other entity, for the operations, maintenance, repair, future upgrades, and future utility systems replacements. The conveyance may consist of all right, title, and interest of the United States in the utility system. UP will be accomplished in accordance with 10 U.S.C. �2688 � Utility Systems: Conveyance Authority. As a result of this solicitation, the Contractor(s) will be selected to assume ownership of the Water utility system. The new owner(s) shall operate and maintain the system and provide utility services to the Government. Any resulting contract, if awarded, will require the Contractor to furnish all facilities, labor, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to own, maintain, and operate the utility system. All responsibility for maintaining reliable service, including such items as environmental compliance, maintenance costs, major system renovations, construction, equipment, manpower, and overhead costs shall become the utility system owner�s responsibility. The Contractor shall manage the maintenance, repairs, replacement, etc., of the system to ensure continuous, adequate, and dependable service for each Government or tenant connection within the service area. The Contractor shall be responsible for funding all capital investments required to acquire, maintain, and operate the utility system in a safe, reliable condition and to meet the requirements listed in the contract. Real property interests will be conveyed in the form of a Right to Access or an Easement as a reference to the resultant contract. The utility system will be conveyed via a Bill of Sale after a transition period to be determined by the Contractor. Past performance information from potential offerors shall be submitted as directed in the solicitation. A Sources Sought Notice for this requirement was previously publicized under solicitation number SP060026R0813 on May 29, 2026. The Sources Sought Notice has closed and market research is complete. This requirement will be unrestricted. All responsible sources are encouraged to submit an offer. Other-than-small businesses are required to submit a subcontracting plan with their offer. Interested sources may contact Jonathan Moore, Contracting Officer at jonathan.moore@dla.mil, Timothy Stark, Contracting Officer at timothy.1.stark@dla.mil, Nikki Rooksby, Contract Specialist at nikki.rooksby@dla.mil, or Lexy Sweitzer, Contract Specialist, at lexy.sweitzer@dla.mil to be added to our offeror mailing list. Secure Documents As this requirement will be an unrestricted, competitive action, several of the solicitation documents will be posted as �secured� on the SAM.gov Contract Opportunities website. In order to view those documents, vendors will need to obtain special access. The process of obtaining access is somewhat lengthy, therefore all interested vendors are encouraged to begin that process as soon as possible. Instructions for obtaining access are provided below. Should any party have issues with obtaining access to SAM.gov or the secure documents, they must notify the contracting office no later than September 29, 2026. Notifications to the contracting office of the inability to access secure documents after that suspense will not be a consideration in extensions to the Request for Proposal date. Utilizarea tehnologiei avansate pentru a înregistra ședințele oficiale și a transforma automat înregistrările audio în transcrieri scrise, facilitând astfel accesul la informații. - SOLUȚIE DE ÎNREGISTRARE, DOCUMENTARE ȘI DISEMINARE A ȘEDINȚELOR ➢ 4. Crearea unor canale diverse de comunicare pentru cetățeni, inclusiv chatbots pentru asistență non-stop și implementarea unui sistem de bugetare participativă, permițând cetățenilor să se implice activ în deciziile administrative - SOLUȚIE DE COMUNICARE CU CETĂȚENII ȘI BUGETARE PARTICIPATIVĂ ➢ 5. Oferirea de materiale educative și sesiuni informative pentru a conștientiza cetățenii despre importanța participării lor în procesul bugetării, precum și despre alte subiecte relevante pentru comunitate - SOLUȚIE DE EDUCARE ȘI DEZVOLTARE DURABILĂ Durata contractului: Durata de prestare a serviciilor prevăzute în prezentul contract este de 6 luni până la recepția finală a serviciilor, începând de la data semnării contractului de către ambele părți sub rezerva constituirii garantiei de buna executie. Termenul pentru recepția cantitativă a soluției este de maxim 5 luni iar termenul pentru recepția calitativă este de cel mult 6 luni calculat de la data semnării contractului de către ambele părți, sub rezerva constituirii garanției de buna execuție. Termenii și condițiile contractului includ și o garanție de cel puțin 2 ani. Perioada de garanție decurge de la data recepției finale şi este egală cel puțin cu perioadele stabilite în caietul de sarcini. Proiectul ” Dezvoltarea unui sistem integrat de recunoaștere facială și soluții de videoconferință pentru ședințe oficiale și interacțiuni cu cetățenii în Mun. Miercurea Ciuc și Comuna Leliceni.” intră sub incidența reglementărilor Comisiei Europene 2021/C 373/01 - ”Orientări tehnice referitoare la imunizarea infrastructurii la schimbările climatice în perioada 2021-2027” privind imunizarea la schimbările climatice, fiind încadrat în categoria de ” alte tipuri de infrastructură eligibile”. În accepțiunea prevederilor art. 2 pct. 42 din Regulamentul (UE) 2021/1060, noțiunea de „imunizare la schimbările climatice” înseamnă un proces de prevenire a vulnerabilității infrastructurii la potențialele efecte pe termen lung ale schimbărilor climatice, asigurându-se în același timp respectarea principiului „eficiența energetică înainte de toate” și faptul că nivelul emisiilor de gaze cu efect de seră generate de proiect este compatibil cu obiectivul privind neutralitatea climatică stabilit pentru 2050; In conformitate cu prevederile art.160 alin. title: Germany – Advertising and marketing services – Fortführung und Weiterentwicklung einer Social-Media- und Web-basierten Informations- und Werbekampagne zur Steigerung der Auslandsmobilität von Studierenden an deutschen Hochschulen
description: Gesucht wird ein Auftragnehmer mit ausgewiesener Expertise im Bereich Social Media und Onlinemarketing für junge Studierende und/oder Schülerinnen und Schüler der gymnasialen Oberstufe. Kern der Kampagne „studieren weltweit – ERLEBE ES!“ ist nutzergenerierter Social-Media-Content von im Ausland studierenden sogenannten „Correspondents“. Der Auftragnehmer verfügt über Erfahrung im Coaching und in der zielgruppengerechten Begleitung solcher Content-Erstellenden. Er übernimmt in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Auftraggeber die strategische und operative Konzeption, Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung der Social-Media-Kampagne sowie ergänzender Onlinemarketing-Maßnahmen, einschließlich Monitoring und Nutzung der gewonnenen Erkenntnisse für Kampagnenplanung und Betreuung der Correspondents. Die Website www.studieren-weltweit.de wird vor dem Hintergrund einer zunehmenden Nutzung KI-gestützter Informationsangebote weiterentwickelt. Die Kampagne soll eine zeitgemäße, innovative und dynamische Ansprache verfolgen. title: Netherlands – Research and development consultancy services – DAS Innovatie- en adviesdiensten
description: De gemeente Den Haag staat voor steeds complexere maatschappelijke opgaven, die vragen om nieuwe oplossingen, innovatieve werkwijzen en aanvullende expertise. Om hier adequaat op in te kunnen spelen, investeren verschillende domeinen en diensten binnen de Gemeente in innovatie en in het versterken van het eigen innovatievermogen. Bij de ontwikkeling en uitvoering van innovatieprocessen bestaat regelmatig behoefte aan aanvullende, specialistische expertise en ondersteuning van externe partijen. Deze behoefte kan per vraagstuk, fase van het innovatieproces en organisatieonderdeel verschillen. Om deze expertise op een flexibele, efficiënte en transparante wijze te kunnen inzetten, kiest de Gemeente voor het inrichten van een Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem (DAS). Binnen dit DAS kunnen marktpartijen die voldoen aan de gestelde toelatings- en geschiktheidseisen worden toegelaten en meedingen naar Nadere opdrachten. Het Schuldenlab070 neemt het initiatief tot het inrichten van een Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem (DAS), gericht op de begeleiding en ondersteuning van innovatieprocessen binnen de gehele gemeentelijke organisatie (gemeente Den Haag). Binnen dit DAS kunnen de verschillende domeinen en diensten op afroep en naar behoefte gespecialiseerde innovatiepartijen inschakelen. Doel hiervan is om expertise flexibel in te zetten ter versterking van het eigen innovatievermogen, en om werkzaamheden efficiënter, effectiever en duurzamer uit te voeren. Het uitgangspunt voor de opdrachten die binnen dit DAS worden uitgevraagd, is het innovatieproces zoals gebruikt bij onder andere het Schuldenlab070 en van EC-DISC (expertise Centrum Digitale innovatie en Smart City). Binnen deze processen worden concepten, experimenten en pilots ingericht en gevalideerd volgens een vaste en gefaseerde aanpak. Onder het innovatieproces vallen diverse standaarddiensten ter begeleiding en ondersteuning van innovatie(processen), waaronder bijvoorbeeld: -Probleemanalyse, trendanalyse en Strategische verkenning; -Het faciliteren en begeleiden van processen, werksessies en co-creatietrajecten; -Het begeleiden van de ontwikkeling en uitwerking van innovatieve concepten; -Projectsturing en programmabegeleiding; -Monitoring en evaluatie, waaronder maatschappelijke kosten-batenanalyses (MKBA) en impact- en effectmetingen. Daarnaast worden er regelmatig evenementen georganiseerd en trainingen gegeven die los staan van het innovatieproces. Het DAS is onderverdeeld in verschillende fasen van het innovatieproces. Ten behoeve van de inrichting en uitvoering van het DAS worden deze categorieën in Mercell/TenderNed als percelen weergegeven. Gegadigden dienen bij hun verzoek tot toelating aan te geven voor welke fase(n) zij in aanmerking wensen te komen. Het is toegestaan om zich voor één, meerdere of alle fasen aan te melden, mits wordt voldaan aan de voor die fase geldende eisen. Hoewel de gemeente binnen dit DAS primair opdrachten op het gebied van procesbegeleiding van sociale en fysieke innovatie zal uitzetten, kunnen ook opdracht worden uitgevraagd op het snijvlak van sociale en digitale innovatie. Hierbij kan gedacht worden aan de inzet van Artificial intelligence (AI) en andere digitale technologieën ter ondersteuning van innovatie, dienstverlening en besluitvorming, gericht op het effectiever aanpakken van sociaal-maatschappelijke opgaven. Onder deze DAS vallen dan de procesbegeleiding, maar niet de daadwerkelijke productontwikkeling van de digitale tools of systemen. Vraagstukken waarvan het primaire doel bestaat uit onderzoek, klantreisonderzoek, servicedesign of UX-design vallen niet onder de reikwijdte van dit DAS. Deze vallen namelijk onder de gemeentebrede raamovereenkomst voor de inhuur van Onderzoeks-, Service Design- en User Experience Design (UX)-medewerkers.

title: Netherlands – Articulated trucks – Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem CLAS - Matlogco - Witte Vloot
description: Bedrijfsprofiel De Aanbestedende dienst is het Materieellogistiek Commando Land (MatlogCo) van de Koninklijke Landmacht - een van de zeven onderdelen van het Ministerie van Defensie. Het MatlogCo is verantwoordelijk voor de instandhouding van het grondgebonden materieel van Defensie. Voor meer informatie over het Ministerie van Defensie en het MatlogCo is de website www.defensie.nl te raadplegen. Dynamisch aankoopsysteem De hierbij gebruikte procedure is het Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem uit de Aanbestedingswet 2012. De procedure verloopt volledig elektronisch via het online aanbestedingsplatform Negometrix. Een Dynamisch aankoopsysteem (DAS) is een elektronisch proces voor het doen van gangbare aankopen van werken, leveringen of diensten, waarvan de kenmerken wegens de algemene beschikbaarheid op de markt voldoen aan onze behoeften. Doelstelling DAS De doelstelling van het DAS is een zo groot mogelijke groep kwalitatief goede ondernemingen toe te laten zonder de beheersbaarheid te verliezen. Op deze manier creëert Defensie een optimale marktwerking, waarbij Defensie kwalitatief optimale Producten kan selecteren tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten, binnen de gewenste levertijden. Het MatlogCo beoogt hiermee op een eerlijke wijze, snel en eenvoudig haar behoeften op te vullen, door middel van volledige concurrentiestelling. Werking van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem in het kort Voor deze aanbesteding volgt Defensie de Europese aanbestedingsprocedure 'Dynamisch aankoopsysteem', conform de Aanbestedingswet. Hierbij wordt onderscheid gemaakt naar twee fasen: 1. Instellingsfase 2. Gunningsfase Deze fasen worden nader uitgewerkt in vragenlijst 1.1. Kort samengevat Gegadigde dient een Verzoek tot toelating in; Als Gegadigde aan de gestelde eisen voldoet en er geen uitsluitingsgronden van toepassing zijn, wordt zij als Deelnemer toegelaten. Toelating tot het DAS houdt geen opdracht in; Het MatlogCo plaats een nadere uitvraag; Deelnemer schrijft in; Het MatlogCo beoordeelt de Inschrijvingen en gunt aan de economisch meest voordelige Inschrijving. Looptijd van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem Bij de publicatie in maart 2023 had het Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem (DAS) een initiële looptijd van 48 maanden. Echter, aangezien deze DAS een voortzetting is van de vorige DAS met het negometrix nummer 210681, resteert er nu nog een looptijd van 35 maanden. Het is belangrijk op te merken dat de Aanbestedende Dienst de looptijd één keer kan verlengen, met een periode van 48 maanden. Het staat de Aanbestedende dienst vrij om aan het DAS gedurende de looptijd producten en/of kwalificaties toe te voegen of te verwijderen. Dit zal de Aanbestedende dienst waar nodig aankondigen met een rectificatie.

title: Ireland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Panel for the provision of Architect Led Services for projects of less than €1 million (ex. VAT) in value
description: Dublin City Council is establishing a Panel for the provision of Architectural Services for projects of less than €1 million (ex. VAT) in value. Panel members will be required to provide architectural design and associated services for stages (i)-(v) of the Capital Works Management Framework (CWMF) or a subset thereof. As part of the service delivery, panel members will be required to provide the following minimum specialist services: • Design Team Lead, • Architect, • Employer’s Representative for works contracts, • Design Certifier (under the Building Control Amendment Regulations 2014) • Assigned Certifier (under the Building Control Amendment Regulations 2014) • PSDP Additional optional specialist services that may be required include Measured Surveys; Condition Surveys; Architectural Conservation Consultancy Services; Accessibility Audits; Design Services for Disability Access Certificates and Fire Safety Consultancy Services. It is intended that the architectural services to be provided will cover the following project types: feasibility studies, residential (new build and refurbishment), public realm, precinct improvements, housing, civic, community, recreational, sports, infrastructural improvement master-planning, mixed use/commercial etc. The services will cover any and all (CWMF) work stages. Only those Applicants capable of delivering all of the minimum specialist services listed above (whether in-house or as a grouping/consortium) will be considered. Therefore, applications relating to one or several of these services only are not acceptable and will be rejected Every effort has been made to ensure that this document contains all the necessary information for the completion of applications. title: Finland – Training and entertainment software development services – HAUS DPS 2026–2030 for Digital Transformation, Innovation and Public Sector Development
description: HAUS Finnish Institute of Public Management Ltd (HAUS) is establishing a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for the period 2026–2030 for the procurement of expert services related to digital transformation, innovation, governance, institutional development and public sector development. The estimated total value of procurements conducted under the DPS during its validity period is approximately EUR 40 million (excluding VAT). The DPS will be used to procure expertise for international development cooperation projects, technical assistance assignments, advisory services, capacity building initiatives, studies, evaluations and other expert services implemented globally. Assignments may be funded by, among others, the European Union, the Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Finland, development finance institutions and other international cooperation partners. Suppliers may apply to one or several categories and, once admitted, will have the opportunity to participate in mini-competitions launched throughout the DPS period 2026–2030. Further information regarding the scope, eligibility requirements and application process is provided in the procurement documents.

title: Netherlands – Supply services of personnel including temporary staff – DAS geëxploiteerd door Werken in Noord-Holland Noord
description: U kunt inschrijven op Inhuurdesk Werken in Noord-Holland Noord Inhuur van tijdelijk personeel De gemeente Schagen maakt per 26 september 2026 voor de inhuur van tijdelijk personeel gebruik van Inhuurdesk Werken in Noord-Holland Noord Conform de nieuwe richtlijnen voor de Aanbestedingswet 2012 is deze inhuurdesk ingericht als Dynamisch Aankoop Systeem (DAS) voor de categorieën: Administratief/secretarieel Automatisering/ICT/GEO/Gis Bestuurlijk Binnendienst/algemene dienst Bouwkunde & Civiele techniek Buitendienst & Groenvoorziening Burger- en publiekszaken Dienstverlening & Facilitair Financieel & Economisch Gezondheidszorg Griffie Hydrologie/ ecologie Juridisch Management & Bedrijfsvoering Onderwijs Openbare Orde en Veiligheid Personeel & Organisatie Ruimtelijke ordening & Milieu Sociale zaken & Werkgelegenheid Sport & Recreatie Techniek (E, WTB, Proces) Vergunning & Handhaving Verkeer & Vervoer Verkoop & Inkoop Voorlichting & Communicatie Welzijn Wetenschap & Cultuur. Deze categorieën zijn het totaal van alle door de aangesloten organisatie gebruikte categorieën. De aangesloten organisatie behoudt zich het recht voor om op een later moment categorieën toe te voegen of te wijzigen. Toevoegingen en/of wijzigingen zullen worden gepubliceerd op Mercell , TenderNed en de website van gemeente Schagen. Omvang Het aantal opdrachten, vanaf schaal 10 Cao gemeenten, is ongeveer 20 op jaarbasis, hieraan kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Ook kunnen gedurende de looptijd nieuwe organisaties aan dit Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem worden toegevoegd. Zij behouden zich het recht voor om jaarlijks, zonder opgaaf van redenen, het DAS te kunnen beëindigen. Looptijd Het DAS voor Inhuurdesk Werken in Noord-Holland Noord wordt ingesteld voor een periode van 2 jaar tot 26 september 2028. Daarna is de optie om 2 maal met een periode van één jaar te verlengen. Het DAS loopt dan uiterlijk op 26 september 2030 af. title: AFLCMC/HNIT seeks expressions of interest regarding a potential commercial coworking space in the environs of Concord, Massachusetts.
description: The purpose of this request for information is to seek responses from interested vendors regarding a potential short-term commercial coworking space service contract for the Enterprise IT as a Service (EITaaS) program, which the agency anticipates that it may award in the summer of 2027. The projected period of performance start date is August 2, 2027. The agency seeks, in particular, responses from vendors that meet the requirements listed below. A draft Performance Work Statement (PWS) has been attached to this notice, which provides additional information on the required services. Responses should clearly indicate whether the vendor believes that it can meet all requirements. If it believes that it cannot, the vendor should specifically identify the requirements that it believes it can meet and those that it believes it cannot meet. Where possible, the vendor shall indicate and describe the particular property or properties that it believes would be suited to this contract, and the nature of its interest in that property (if any). The agency anticipates, in accordance with Department of the Air Force (DAF) Contract Policy Memo 24-C-10, that the PSC shall be X1AB (Lease/Rental of Conference Space and Facilities) and the NAICS shall be 531120. Note that this service contract, if awarded, will be in full accordance with the requirements set forth in the memo. Property Management: The contractor shall provide an environment that meets the requirements outlined in the Performance Work Statement. It shall be approximately within a 6-mile radius of the Concord Town House, 22 Monument Square, Concord, MA (with the approximate coordinates being 42�27'40.1"N 71�20'55.0"W). (The agency may consider an environment outside of this 6-mile radius if it determines that it is in its best interest to do so.) It shall have roughly 30,000 square feet of office space; it shall contain 190 or more workstations, 6 to 8 private �office pods� or �booths� (each of a size sufficient to accommodate one individual), 4 small collaborative spaces (each of a size sufficient to accommodate up to 6 individuals), a commercial lactation pod, and 6 to 8 meeting rooms, with a personnel range of 151-175 individuals when fully operational, and potentially 176-200 individuals to meet future programmatic demands. It shall have a break area/dining area and a shared kitchen area that meet the requirements specified in the PWS. The parking lot or garage shall have a capacity sufficient for all personnel. Within the coworking space, the contractor shall provide a dedicated, private, exclusive fully enclosed office for the operational use of authorized DAF personnel, which meets the security, structural, and other specifications listed in the PWS. IT Support and Maintenance Services: The vendor shall provide IT support for the coworking space�s workstations and conference equipment. It shall provide on-site technical support staffing. It shall monitor the equipment and the IT infrastructure to ensure that equipment is free from defects, that equipment is operable, and that connectivity is maintained. If the vendor observes any actual or potential information security violations in the course of providing this support, it shall report them to the Government Security Manager. Administrative and Janitorial Services: The vendor shall ensure that restrooms are restocked and maintained, that the shared kitchen and kitchen appliances are maintained, that shared kitchen supplies are restocked (including the restocking of the commercial coffee machine and beverage dispenser), that meeting rooms, open seating areas, and other elements of the coworking space are maintained, shall provide front desk staffing, and shall otherwise administer the coworking space in accordance with commercial practices and with agency-specific needs. Software Licenses, Collaboration Licenses, Network Services, Power/Utility Services, and Commercial Wi-Fi: The contractor shall provide these services in accordance with the PWS. Hardware and Enclosures: The contractor shall install and maintain contractor-owned or contractor-leased hardware and equipment (e.g. printers) and shall install and maintain government-owned hardware and equipment (e.g. large-format displays and computer monitors) in accordance with the PWS. It shall permit the installation of a lockable, ventilated, government-owned IT equipment rack or wall-mounted communications cabinet within the dedicated space. This notice is not a solicitation and does not bind the agency in any way. If the agency opts to post a solicitation, it will only consider those bidders that are actively registered on SAM.gov at the time of issuance of the solicitation. Responses are due by 12:00 PM EDT on October 27, 2026, and should be emailed to Contract Specialist Steven C. Bodnar at steven.bodnar@us.af.mil and Contract Specialist Andrew C. St. Maurice at andrew.st_maurice@us.af.mil.

title: AFLCMC/HNIT seeks expressions of interest regarding a potential commercial coworking space in the environs of Concord, Massachusetts.
description: The purpose of this request for information is to seek responses from interested vendors regarding a potential short-term commercial coworking space service contract for the Enterprise IT as a Service (EITaaS) program, which the agency anticipates that it may award in the summer of 2027. The projected period of performance start date is August 2, 2027. The agency seeks, in particular, responses from vendors that meet the requirements listed below. A draft Performance Work Statement (PWS) has been attached to this notice, which provides additional information on the required services. Responses should clearly indicate whether the vendor believes that it can meet all requirements. If it believes that it cannot, the vendor should specifically identify the requirements that it believes it can meet and those that it believes it cannot meet. Where possible, the vendor shall indicate and describe the particular property or properties that it believes would be suited to this contract, and the nature of its interest in that property (if any). The agency anticipates, in accordance with Department of the Air Force (DAF) Contract Policy Memo 24-C-10, that the PSC shall be X1AB (Lease/Rental of Conference Space and Facilities) and the NAICS shall be 531120. Note that this service contract, if awarded, will be in full accordance with the requirements set forth in the memo. Property Management: The contractor shall provide an environment that meets the requirements outlined in the Performance Work Statement. It shall be approximately within a 6-mile radius of the Concord Town House, 22 Monument Square, Concord, MA (with the approximate coordinates being 42�27'40.1"N 71�20'55.0"W). (The agency may consider an environment outside of this 6-mile radius if it determines that it is in its best interest to do so.) It shall have roughly 30,000 square feet of office space; it shall contain 190 or more workstations, 6 to 8 private �office pods� or �booths� (each of a size sufficient to accommodate one individual), 4 small collaborative spaces (each of a size sufficient to accommodate up to 6 individuals), a commercial lactation pod, and 6 to 8 meeting rooms, with a personnel range of 151-175 individuals when fully operational, and potentially 176-200 individuals to meet future programmatic demands. It shall have a break area/dining area and a shared kitchen area that meet the requirements specified in the PWS. The parking lot or garage shall have a capacity sufficient for all personnel. Within the coworking space, the contractor shall provide a dedicated, private, exclusive fully enclosed office for the operational use of authorized DAF personnel, which meets the security, structural, and other specifications listed in the PWS. IT Support and Maintenance Services: The vendor shall provide IT support for the coworking space�s workstations and conference equipment. It shall provide on-site technical support staffing. It shall monitor the equipment and the IT infrastructure to ensure that equipment is free from defects, that equipment is operable, and that connectivity is maintained. If the vendor observes any actual or potential information security violations in the course of providing this support, it shall report them to the Government Security Manager. Administrative and Janitorial Services: The vendor shall ensure that restrooms are restocked and maintained, that the shared kitchen and kitchen appliances are maintained, that shared kitchen supplies are restocked (including the restocking of the commercial coffee machine and beverage dispenser), that meeting rooms, open seating areas, and other elements of the coworking space are maintained, shall provide front desk staffing, and shall otherwise administer the coworking space in accordance with commercial practices and with agency-specific needs. Software Licenses, Collaboration Licenses, Network Services, Power/Utility Services, and Commercial Wi-Fi: The contractor shall provide these services in accordance with the PWS. Hardware and Enclosures: The contractor shall install and maintain contractor-owned or contractor-leased hardware and equipment (e.g. printers) and shall install and maintain government-owned hardware and equipment (e.g. large-format displays and computer monitors) in accordance with the PWS. It shall permit the installation of a lockable, ventilated, government-owned IT equipment rack or wall-mounted communications cabinet within the dedicated space. This notice is not a solicitation and does not bind the agency in any way. If the agency opts to post a solicitation, it will only consider those bidders that are actively registered on SAM.gov at the time of issuance of the solicitation. Responses are due by 12:00 PM EDT on October 27, 2026, and should be emailed to Contract Specialist Steven C. Bodnar at steven.bodnar@us.af.mil and Contract Specialist Andrew C. St. Maurice at andrew.st_maurice@us.af.mil.

Afin de bénéficier des meilleures conditions économiques, il est préconisé de renouveler cet accord-cadre tous les 36 mois. Il s'agit D4un accord-cadre à bons de commande mono-attributaire, sans minimum et avec un maximum annuel de 900 000,00 euro(s) HT, passé en procédure d'appel d'offres ouvert. L'éditeur Autodesk commercialise ses licences par l'intermédiaire d'un réseau de revendeurs agréés. Le présent accord-cadre a donc vocation à permettre l'acquisition de ces licences ainsi que des prestations associées auprès d'un titulaire disposant des habilitations requises. L'accord-cadre n'est pas alloti car les prestations présentent un caractère homogène et fortement interdépendant, dont l'exécution par un titulaire unique est de nature à assurer la cohérence technique et la bonne exécution des prestations

title: Germany – Vocational training services – 10018858-Implementation of TVET support and women's economic empowerment activities in Sierra Leone
description: Sierra Leone faces persistent poverty, high informality and limited job creation, disproportionately affecting women and youth. Agriculture is the largest employer, yet value chains are fragmented, processing is weak, and access to finance, quality infrastructure and certification is limited. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) system suffers from outdated curricula, insufficient equipment and low private sector engagement, constraining labour market relevance, especially for women and returnees. The "Youth Employment Promotion through Socio Ecological and Economic Transformation of selected rural Value Chains" (EET project), commissioned by BMZ with EU co funding, supports inclusive, market oriented growth and better employment along selected value chains (cassava, coffee/cocoa, vegetables, poultry). It strengthens micro, small and medium sized enterprises (MSMEs) and the enabling ecosystem, with a strong focus on Women's Economic Empowerment (WEE) and youth integration. The project applies a concise multi level approach: support MSMEs with training, coaching and finance to improve productivity and market access; strengthen ecosystem actors (finance, certification, cooperatives, processing centres) to enhance services and linkages; and upgrade TVET through demand driven Competence Based Education and Training (CBET) curricula, improved facilities at Government Technical Institutes (GTIs) in Kabala, Kailahun, Koidu and Mattru Jong, teacher capacity building and institutionalised private sector engagement for apprenticeships and certification via Industry Sector Advisory Committees. WEE is embedded throughout. The project strengthens six representative bodies advancing women's economic rights (e.g. Gender Equality and Women's Empowerment - GEWE - Act), introduces gender transformative modules (Gender makes Business Sense - GmBS; Gender Action Learning Systems - GALS; Gender Model Family - GMF) via public and private providers, and delivers mentoring and awareness campaigns to address norms and improve women"s access to resources, markets and decision making. Outcomes are tracked with recognised tools such as the (pro )Women's Empowerment in Agriculture Index (pro WEAI). Key results targeted include: - Improved competitiveness of MSMEs with measurable employment effects for women and youth. - Upgraded GTIs and at least nine demand oriented, gender responsive curricula operational; teachers trained in learner centred CBET; trainees certified in line with National Council for Technical and Vocational Education (NCTVE) standards in the initial phase. - Stronger institutional conditions for women's economic participation, including operational representative bodies, integrated gender transformative modules, and functioning mentoring and communication platforms. - Enhanced market access through strengthened outgrower networks, cooperative services and business linkages, enabling more equitable participation of women and young producers. The approach is rights based, conflict and context sensitive, and climate aware. It promotes green and circular economy elements in training and enterprise support, limits environmental footprints and applies Do No Harm principles. Implementation aligns with national policies (TVET Policy, Dual Apprenticeship Policy) under the coordination of the Ministry of Planning and Economic Development, with the Ministry of Technical and Higher Education (MTHE) and NCTVE responsible for TVET standards and certification, and the Ministry of Gender and Children's Affairs and civil society partners advancing WEE. Continuous monitoring, learning and adaptive management ensure data driven steering and accountability to BMZ and the EU. EU visibility will follow EU visual identity guidelines; co branding with BMZ/GIZ will follow donor rules.?

title: PA161/PA103A2 Metal Containers for the 155mm Modular Artillery Charge System (MACS) M231/232
description: The U.S. Army Contracting Command � Rock Island (RI) at Picatinny, in support of the Office of the Project Manager Combat Ammunition Systems (PM CAS), has a requirement for the production of PA161/PA103A2 Metal Containers in support of the 155mm Modular Artillery Charge System (MACS) M231/M232 and variants. This effort is for a new 5-year sole-source Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity contract with Firm-Fixed-Price delivery orders to support FY2027-31 requirements. This action is a follow-on contract for the continued production of PA161/PA103A2 Metal Containers. The new sole-source award will be made to Conco, Inc. located in Louisville, KY on an other than full and open competition basis utilizing Title 10 United States Code (U.S.C.) Section 3204(a)(3) as implemented by Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) 6.103-3 (Industrial Mobilization; Engineering, Developmental, or Research Capability; or Expert Services). Award is projected for 3rd Qtr FY27. In accordance with RFO 16.504-1(b), the contract will include a minimum guarantee in the amount of $5.2 million. The estimated maximum contract value for this new effort is $586M. The production quantities over the 5 years would be as follows: PA161 Metal Containers: 920,145 and PA103A2 Metal Containers: 3,090,060. The PA161/PA103A2 containers are currently produced by Conco, Inc. The PA161 and PA103A2 Metal Containers are square-rimmed 6-inch diameter cylindrical steel shipping and storage containers between 31 and 38 inches in length and used for the 155mm M231 and M232 MACS. Two different propelling charges of the 155mm M231 and M232-series provide a complete zoning solution for 155mm artillery applications by using multiples of basic increment. The M231 charges are used at lower zones (Zones 1 and 2), while M232-series charges are used at progressively higher zones. A total of four M231 MACS are packed per PA161 container, while five M232A2 MACS are packed per PA103A2 container. These containers were developed to protect the MACS charges throughout the Army's stringent logistic environments and have design features that improve the insensitive munitions characteristics for the MACS system. Level III Government-Owned Technical Data Packages (TDPs) are available for the PA161 and PA103A2 Metal Containers and will be used for this requirement. The TDPs are coded as Distribution Statement D (authorized distribution of technical documents to the Department of War (DoW) and U.S. DoW Contractors only). A fully executed DD Form 2345 and a completed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) will be required prior to receiving the TDPs. The point of contact for the TDP request will be Ms. Giuliana Turriciano, giuliana.turriciano.civ@army.mil. This is a Pre-Solicitation notice, and the Government anticipates release of the Request for Proposal (RFP) in December 2026. Any information or exchanges between contractors and the Government concerning this notice are at no additional cost and/or obligation to the Government. The associated North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) for this effort is 332439. Contractors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database by accessing the SAM website at http://www.sam.gov to be eligible for contract award. This notice does not constitute a formal RFP, nor is the Government obligated to issue an RFP. However, interested sources may submit a capability statement demonstrating their firm's technical ability of this requirement. All inquiries shall be made via e-mail only. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted. The point of contacts for this requirement are the Procurement Officer via renee.k.prendergast.civ@army.mil AND the Contract Specialist at giuliana.turriciano.civ@army.mil.

title: Sovereign Cloud Invitation to Qualify
description: * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * NOTICE OF INVITATION TO QUALIFY UPDATE #1 - 2026-10-16 This update is to: • Extend the closing date for the first intake period to October 26, 2026 EDT. • Publish a new version of the Invitation to Qualify (ITQ) document. All changes are flagged in the left margin of the modified document. The document is available under the "Bidding Details" tab • Notify interested vendors that the slideshow used during the webinar held on October 8, 2026 is available under the "Bidding Details" tab • Notify interested vendors that an initial consolidated set of Questions and Answers received during the webinar and by email is available under the "Bidding Details" tab. Additional supplier questions have been received and are currently under review. Canada may publish further consolidated Questions and Answers, as appropriate. * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * NATIONAL SECURITY EXCEPTION In respect of all phases of the solicitation, SSC has invoked the National Security Exception (NSE). As such, this invocation exempts all phases of the procurement processes for sovereign cloud services from the application of all of Canada’s trade agreements, including the World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement (Article III(1)) and the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (Article 801). 1. INTRODUCTION The Government of Canada (GC) is advancing its digital infrastructure and hosting capabilities to meet evolving operational requirements and to deliver services to Canadians that are secure, reliable, and user-centric. Building on findings and industry feedback obtained through prior engagement activities, Shared Services Canada (SSC) is establishing a structured Sovereign Cloud Qualification Process as an initial step to support future procurements. The Sovereign Cloud Qualification process is intended to: • Establish a standing entry point for Canadian-owned and -controlled businesses seeking to qualify to participate in sovereign cloud procurements • Enable Canada to collect information on available and emerging offerings to support market awareness and procurement planning • Provide a consistent, transparent, and accessible mechanism for industry engagement • This Notice of Planned Procurement does not constitute a commitment by Canada to issue any solicitation or to procure any services. 2. PROCESS OVERVIEW The Sovereign Cloud Qualification Process is supported by an Invitation to Qualify (ITQ). The ITQ defines the requirements for qualification, including: • Eligibility conditions • Submission requirements • Supporting documentation • Process instructions The qualification process serves as the entry point and a mandatory step for vendors to participate in current and future sovereign cloud procurement processes. Vendors that participate in the qualification process and meet the eligibility conditions defined in the ITQ will be considered as Qualified Respondents (QR) for participation in future sovereign cloud procurement opportunities. This qualification process is not a competitive procurement process and will not result in a contract award. It is intended solely to establish a list of qualified vendors for participation in future procurement activities. 3. ELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS Eligibility conditions details are defined in the ITQ (available in tab “Bidding Details” above). At a minimum, eligibility conditions include: - Confirmation of Respondent’s Canadian ownership and control, including parent companies. - Submission of a Value Proposition describing the respondent’s sovereign cloud offerings. 4. OBJECTIVE AND SCOPE 4.1 Objective The objective of the Sovereign Cloud Services procurement stream is to strengthen Canada’s cloud posture by enabling and supporting solutions that advance Canadian control over data and services, and protection from foreign legal or extraterritorial authority. The sovereign cloud procurement stream is intended to complement, and not replace, existing cloud procurement approaches. 4.2 Scope (Indicative Only) The service categories described below are indicative only and provided to inform respondents of the types of capabilities Canada may consider procuring in the future. Additional requirements, eligibility conditions, certifications, or evaluation criteria will be defined in future procurement stages once the procurement process is confirmed The scope of the Sovereign Cloud Services procurement stream may include, but is not limited to: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS): This category may include sovereign fundamental computing resources such as processing, storage, and networking. These services allow departments to deploy and run their own software, including operating systems and applications. While the cloud provider manages the underlying infrastructure, Canada retains control over operating systems, storage, deployed applications, and certain network configuration. Platform as a Service (PaaS): This category may include sovereign cloud services that allow departments to deploy and run applications built using programming languages, libraries, services, and tools supported by the provider. The provider manages the underlying infrastructure, including networks, servers, operating systems, and storage, while Canada retains control over the applications it deploys and the configuration of the application hosting environment. AI enabling services: This category may include sovereign services that support the development, deployment, or operation of artificial intelligence solutions, such as machine learning platforms, model hosting, data processing environments, and AI infrastructure. Managed Service Providers of Classified Cloud Solutions: This category may include managed services for classified cloud solutions. Vendors intending to operate as infrastructure providers will be required to provide certification from a recognized classified cloud solution provider in the Five Eyes confirming their authorization and agreement to deliver classified cloud services and associated managed solutions. Recognizing that many classified and unclassified cloud solutions are operated or owned by foreign providers, Canada may also consider managed service providers that have unique access to such cloud service solutions, even where those solutions are owned by foreign entities. In such cases, the managed service provider will need to demonstrate full control over the technology and the delivery of services. Other cloud or cloud enabling capabilities that support sovereign digital service delivery. This category may include other sovereign cloud or cloud-enabling capabilities not otherwise described in the indicative scopes provided above. 5. SUBMISSION PROCEDURES To participate in the Sovereign Cloud Qualification process, respondents must complete and submit the designated submission form in accordance with the requirements set out in the ITQ. 6. PROCESS AND TIMELINES The Sovereign Cloud Qualification process is open, ongoing, and continuously available through CanadaBuys. The ITQ defines intake periods and closing dates. The first intake period closing date is set to October 19, 2026. Following the end of each intake period, or more often at SSC’s discretion, responses will be assessed and each Respondent will be notified of its qualification status within 20 working days. SSC reserves the right to update, amend, or discontinue the Sovereign Cloud Qualification process at any time. 7. INFORMATION WEBINAR Vendors are invited to attend an Informational Webinar to discuss any questions you may have on the ITQ. Interested vendors must register by contacting the Contracting Authority before October 6, 2026, 23:59 Pacific Time, at the following email address: PVRCloudServicesRCRs.DCCServicesinfonuagiquesARF@ssc-spc.gc.ca. title: Field-Scale Simulation Modelling and Agrohydrologic Assessment Services for Prairie Cropping Systems
description: DESCRIPTION: Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) AAFC requires a Contractor to conduct field-scale, process-based simulation modelling using measured soil, crop, nutrient, and management datasets from AAFC research fields in Manitoba, and to develop calibrated and evaluated model configurations suitable for assessing, at whole field and management-zone scales, the impacts of alternative cropping systems and climate variability on: • Crop productivity (e.g., yield, biomass) for crops such as wheat, canola, soybean, barley, and/or other crops represented in AAFC datasets; • Soil water dynamics (e.g., soil moisture, plant-available water, water stress indices, drainage/leaching indicators as supported by the modelling framework); • Evapotranspiration (ET) and related water balance components (as supported by the modelling framework and available inputs); • Nutrient cycling and loss indicators, including nitrogen (N) and phosphorus (P) loss pathways (e.g., leaching/runoff/loss indicators as supported by the model framework); and • Long-term soil carbon dynamics (e.g., soil organic carbon trajectories under alternative rotations and management, as supported by the modelling framework and available datasets). This work will include simulation-based evaluation of cash crop systems and exploration of integrating cover crops and/or perennial phases into Prairie rotations, leveraging established cultivar coefficients/parameters where available in the selected model(s) (e.g., DSSAT or equivalent process-based model, including EPIC, APEX/ArcAPEX, DNDC, DayCent, STICS, APSIM, or RZWQM). A parallel agricultural hydrology component will strengthen the representation and evaluation of soil water processes using available AAFC soil moisture, yield, soil physical/chemical properties, and annual fertility datasets. The contract period is anticipated from December 1, 2026 to November 30, 2027 with an irrevocable option to extend it for up to one additional one-year period. The responsive bid with the highest combined rating of technical merit and price will be recommended for award of a contract. title: France – Software package and information systems – FOURNITURE D’UNE SOLUTION DE FEEDBACK MANAGEMENT (ENQUETES DE SATISFACTION CLIENTS & NPS) ET PRESTATIONS ASSOCIEES
description: . Les directions des branches Services-Courrier-Colis (BSCC) et Grand Public et Numérique (BGPN) de La Poste, représentant six volets fonctionnels, souhaitent renouveler leur solution de Feedback Management et d'Écoute Client. L'objectif est de se doter d’une solution en mode SaaS pour l'administration et la gestion des enquêtes de satisfaction : - création de l'enquête, - programmation, - routage ... - jusque l'exploitation du verbatim, - la restitution des avis et résultats - et en dernier lieu la possibilité de donner une réponse personnalisée au destinataire de l’enquête. . La solution devra permettre la restitution des résultats à tous les maillons de l'organisation (Siège et Territoires), via une connexion SSO, avec des profils et rôles d’utilisateurs différents. . La solution devra permettre la création de dashboard en autonomie selon le type de profil. Les flux de données proviennent de plusieurs SI internes et externes à La Poste, selon les typologies d'enquêtes. . La solution SaaS devra donc s'interfacer avec d'autres outils de La Poste. Les enquêtes couvrent des prestations de services variées au sein de La Poste pour l'ensemble des Directions citées. Chaque Direction a des besoins spécifiques. . La solution devra se conformer au Règlement Général sur la Protection des Données (RGPD). . Le traitement des données personnelles de La Poste, y compris l’hébergement, la sauvegarde et/ou la consultation devra impérativement être localisé au sein de l'Union Européenne (UE), d’un pays de l’Espace Economique Européen (EEE), d’un pays reconnu comme adéquat par l’Union Européenne.. La solution devra également respecter la Politique de Sécurité des SI du Groupe La Poste (PSSIG).

description: Request for Proposal (RFP) - 15BRRC26R00000009 Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services and Home Confinement (HC) services for male and female offenders located within city limits of Pawtucket, Rhode Island. Home Confinement radius is within 100 miles of the RRC facility. The Federal Bureau of Prisons is seeking concerns having the ability for providing Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services (in-house RRC beds) and Home Confinement services (home confinement placements) for male and female Federal offenders held under the authority of United States Statutes which are located within city limits of Pawtucket, Rhode Island. Home Confinement radius is within 100 miles of the RRC facility. Both the RRC services for in-house RRC beds and the Home Confinement services for home confinement placements shall be in accordance with the Federal Bureau of Prisons Statement of Work (SOW) entitled, �Residential Reentry Center, March, 2022�. Home Confinement services (for home confinement placements) are specifically defined in chapter 10, programs, of the SOW. Additional requirements for these services are referenced throughout the SOW as well. This will be a Firm-Fixed Price/IDIQ contract for services with a one-year base period, and four one-year options periods. The RRC In-House requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 8 beds (8 males and 0 females) and an estimated maximum 20 beds facility in which 18 beds will be designated for males and 2 beds designated for females. The Home Confinement requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 3 placements and an estimated maximum 8 placements to include both male and female. It is the intent of the Government to award both line items (RRC in-house beds and home confinement placements) to a single provider, as these services are interconnected and rely upon each other to ensure adequate programming and case management of offenders. D.h. der Auftraggeber wird maximal bis zum Höchstwert von 150% der Gesamtangebotssumme Leistungen aus diesem Rahmenvertrag abrufen. title: Idaho Panhandle National Forest UTV and Track Set Purchase
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products prepared in accordance with the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. The U.S. Forest Service (USFS), Idaho Panhandle National Forests, has a requirement for the procurement and delivery of one (1) Utility Task Vehicle (UTV) and one (1) compatible all-season track kit. The equipment will be utilized by the Fire/Fuels program for wildland fire suppression and prescribed fire operations over severe, uneven terrain. All equipment must be delivered new, fully assembled, fluids serviced, and in a 100% turnkey state ready for immediate field deployment upon arrival. Note: The UTV does not have to arrive with the track set physically installed on the vehicle. However, the vehicle must be fully prepped and the track kit must arrive brand new, complete, and ready to be installed by a certified dealer To be considered responsive, contractors must submit combined pricing for both line items below: CLIN 0001: Utility Task Vehicle (UTV) Quantity: 1 EA Delivery Location: IDAHO PANHANDLE NATIONAL FORESTS SUPERVISORS OFFICE 3232 WEST NURSERY ROAD COEUR D'ALENE ID 83815 CLIN 0002: All-Season Track Kit Quantity: 1 EA Specifications: Must be 100% factory-compatible, field-interchangeable, and align directly with the vehicle awarded under CLIN 0001. Salient Characteristics (Minimum Technical Specifications) Proposed vehicles must meet or exceed the following design limits and features: Engine & Cooling: 4-stroke, liquid-cooled engine. Cylinder Displacement: Min: 998 cc | Max: 1500 cc. Horsepower: Min: 80 hp | Max: 150 hp. Dimensions: Length (120�138 in), Width (63�66 in), Height (76�82 in). Ground Clearance: Min: 13 in | Max: 20 in. Capacities: Person Capacity (2�3), Payload (1000�1700 lbs), Box Capacity (1000�1500 lbs), Towing Capacity (2500�3500 lbs). Tires: 8 to 10 ply; Size Min: 27 x 9 x 14 | Max: 30 x 11 x 15. Included Accessories/Features: Enclosed cab with full doors, hard top roof, glass full tip-out windshield with wipers, sliding window rear panel, heater/defroster, protection headache rack, front/rear a-arm protectors, skid plate, front/rear bumpers, fender flares, rock sliders, chainsaw mount, LED light bar, rearview mirror, and a >4,500 lb winch. Track Specs: Rubber tracks with a steel frame designed for all-season flotation/traction. Minimum 2-year warranty on tracks; minimum 1-year warranty on the UTV. Origin: Must be manufactured in the U.S. Delivery & Shipping Terms Delivery Timeline: All items must be physically delivered within 90 calendar days from the formal date of award. Shipping: FOB Destination. Pricing must be fully inclusive of all freight, handling, and delivery charges. The contractor is responsible for offloading equipment at the specified facility. title: Maintenance, Repair and Preservation of IX-551
description: The Regional Maintenance Center at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard and Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS and IMF) intends to award a stand-alone Firm-Fixed-Price contract to accomplish maintenance, repair, and preservation of IX-551. The IX-551 characteristics are Length: 260 FT, Width: 85 FT, Age: 10 Years, Hull Type: Steel, Draft: 8 FT 6 IN, Full Displacement: 3,070 L Tons and Light Load: 2,267 L Tons. The Contractors facility must possess the capability of IX-551 with the dimensions as stated above. To facilitate proper government oversight, the facility shall be located in the Puget Sound, WA region. For this procurement, the Puget Sound, WA region is defined as the West Coast of the continental US, starting from Olympia, WA and extending northward to Bellingham, WA. Scope Overview: Coordinate with the Contracting Officer, via the SUPERVISOR to deliver the Asset to the Contractors facility. Upon docking the Asset, wash, and clean the exterior surfaces of the Asset. Blast and preserve all exterior hull surfaces, underwater body, freeboard, moon pools and bulwark surfaces of the Asset. Fill, drain, air test, inspect each underwater skeg on the Asset. Accomplish visual inspections of hull and body and all tank/voids. Remove existing and install new zinc anodes and hardware on the underwater hull. Shift the Asset on the blocks to achieve 100 percent preservation of underwater hull. Apply non-skid system to main deck and 02/03 level decks. Accomplish preliminary and final air tests to tanks/voids. Open, pump, ventilate, gas free and clean all tanks. Accomplish partial preservation of Qty (24 EA) tanks. Preserve tank/void manhole covers. Identify distinguishing figures and markings, Remove, clean and reinstall rubber fenders. Open and inspect all pumps and overboard discharge valves. Accomplish visual inspection and final closeout inspection of each tank/void upon completion of all work. Install new manhole gaskets and fasteners. Undock the Asset. Arrange and coordinate the delivery of the Asset back to the Government with the Contracting Officer via the SUPERVISOR. Specific details of all work items and tasks required by this Statement of Work or described in this Scope Overview are included in section 3.0 of the Statement of Work. title: Maintenance and Repairs of Aboveground Storage Tanks (AST) and Underground Storage Tanks (UST) at the Naval Station Newport; Naval Undersea Warfare Center, Newport Rhode Island and Other Areas of Responsibility (AOR)
description: This is not a request for either a quote or proposal, or an invitation for bid. The intent of this pre-solicitation synopsis is to notify potentials of a Facility Support, Firm Fixed Price (FFP)/Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ), Performance-Based contract with recurring and non-recurring services to perform Maintenance and Repairs of Aboveground Storage Tanks (AST) and Underground Storage Tanks (UST) at the Naval Station Newport Naval Undersea Warfare Center, Newport Rhode Island. General Work Requirements: Annex 1502000 - Facility Investment The contractor shall provide labor, management, supervision, tools, material and equipment, required to perform: Maintenance and Repair of Above Ground Storage Tanks (AST), Underground Storage Tanks (UST), leak detection systems, Emergency, Urgent and Routine (E/U/R) Work, Integrated Maintenance Program (IMP), AST/UST Inspection and Maintenance Program, and Hazardous Waste (HW) Disposal as described in the Performance Work Statement (PWS). The work identified is to be provided by means of a Facility Support, Firm Fixed Price (FFP)/Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract with recurring and non-recurring services. Source Selection procedures will be used to select the proposal that provides the best Offeror using the Tradeoff analysis in accordance with FAR Part 15 � Source Selection Process. The solicitation and resulting contract award will be a performance-based service acquisition made to the responsible offeror whose proposal, conforming to the Request for Proposals (RFP), will be advantageous to the Government price and other evaluation factors considered. The Offeror�s proposal shall contain a response to each of the evaluation factors and shall be in the form prescribed by the solicitation. The solicitation requires the evaluation of price and the following non-price factors: Factor 1 � Technical/ Approach Management Factor 2 � Corporate Experience Factor 3 � Safety Factor 4 � Past Performance. NOTE: The relative order of importance of the non-cost/price evaluation factors is; the technical factors (Factors 1, 2, and 3) are of equal importance to each other and, when combined, are equal in importance to the past performance evaluation/performance confidence assessment (Factor 4). When the proposal is evaluated as a whole, the technical factors and past performance/performance confidence assessment factor combined (i.e., the non-cost/price evaluation factors) are approximately equal to price. For Factor 2 Corporate Experience and Factor 4 Past Performance: The offeror shall submit projects that are similar in size, scope and complexity to the solicitation. Size: A contract with a yearly value of at least $200,000.00 for recurring services. Scope: Offeror must have provided all labor, management, supervision, tools, material, and equipment for Facility Investment Services for the Maintenance and Repairs of Aboveground Storage Tanks (AST) and Underground Storage Tanks (UST) as described in the Performance Work Statement (PWS). Complexity: Offeror must have been responsible for responding simultaneously to requirements for several customers or installations. Offers shall be submitted for the performance of work for a period of one year. However, the initial term of the contract may be for a period of less than one year. The Government has the option to extend the term of the contract services for additional periods of one to twelve months. The contract will be for a base period with 4 (four) twelve-month option periods which, cumulatively, will not exceed sixty (60) months. The proposed procurement will be issued as a NAVFAC Mid-Atlantic Contract with online ordering capability using FedMall for the Non-Recurring Exhibit Line Item Numbers (ELINs). Acceptance of Government Purchase Credit Cards is required along with the purchase of FedMall Encrypted software. The North American Classification System (NAICS) for this procurement is 562998; the size standard is $16.5 million. The proposed procurement listed herein is a Competitive Full and Open/ Unrestricted procurement. The RFP will be made available in electronic format only (Adobe Acrobat (.pdf)) and will be posted on the SAM.gov website around 29 October 2026. The estimated proposal due date shall be at least 30 days after the RFP is posted. title: Belgium – Software package and information systems – Gebruik en onderhoud van CIED software
description: Er is een groeiende populatie van patiënten met een cardiac implantable electronic device (CIED), zoals pacemakers, defibrillatoren en loop recorders. De medische en technische opvolging van deze patiënten en toestellen vergt een goede structurele dataverzameling. Ook de wettelijk bepaalde oprichting van de contactpunten materiovigilantie (KB15/11/2017) binnen de zorginstellingen vraagt daarnaast een goede opvolging van alle incidenten met deze implantaten. De opvolging van deze toestellen verschuift meer en meer naar een telecardiologische opvolging op afstand, waardoor er goede documentatie van het dataverkeer en medische acties nodig is. Momenteel is er binnen het KWS geen structurele dataopslag en workflow van deze informatie van patiënten met een CIED voorzien. Met NexuzHealth loopt een project waarbij een structureel CIED-dossier binnen het KWS wordt ontworpen dat binnen verschillende ziekenhuizen kan gebruikt worden. Hierin willen we de verschillende informatie-stromen uit hospitalisatie, ambulante en telecardiologische zorg “patient centered” verzamelen en voorstellen binnen een uniform dashboard. Door de informatie vanuit deze verschillende datastromen eenduidige te coderen kunnen deze op dezelfde plek landen. Hierdoor is telkens de meest recente informatie gecentraliseerd beschikbaar. Met NexuzHealth werd er een mapping uitgevoerd van de gewenste velden en de overeenkomstige definities in de internationaal erkende IEEE standaard (IEEE Std 11073‐10103) die de dataexport structureert over verschillende producenten van CIED. Deze vertaling moet gebeuren op meerdere platformen zowel voor in-huis controle als via webportals waar de gegevens van de thuis opvolging binnen komt. Een voorstudie van NexuzHealth toonde echter aan dat de producenten deze standaard nog niet uniform toepassen. Een ‘vertaling’ van de aangeleverde data door de verschillende producenten kan niet opgenomen worden door NexuzHealth en vergt inschakeling van een derde partij (‘middle ware vendor’).

Hallintatyökalun tulee mahdollistaa keskitetty hallinta saapuvien viestien, kommenttien ja mainintojen käsittelyyn, oman sosiaalisen median viestinnän suorituskyvyn seurannan sosiaalisen median palveluiden analytiikan perusteella, verkkokeskustelujen kuuntelun sekä sosiaalisen median sisällön seurannan ja analysoinnin alustalle asetettujen räätälöityjen kyselyjen ja hälytysten perusteella.
